headline: SILVER SURGES 5% AS GOLD HOLDS $4,083 ON FOMC EVE — Ratio Collapses From 71.1 to 68.9; 6th Consecutive Supply Deficit Looms
snippet: With the FOMC set to announce its rate decision Wednesday July 29, silver is surging approximately 5% on Tuesday while gold holds flat at $4,083 — a single-session divergence that compressed the gold-silver ratio from 71.1 to 68.9. GoldSilver.com notes the outperformance reflects markets pricing in both the 89% hold consensus and a recovery in industrial demand sentiment; the silver market enters its sixth consecutive annual supply deficit (46.3 million ounce projected shortfall), and LBMA's 2026 analyst consensus of $79.57/oz remains 35% above current spot.

headline: FIREFLY'S GREEN BAY PEA DUE AUGUST — 42m @ 6.1% CuEq Core Zone, A$196M Cash Back Upscaled Production Restart Study (ASX/TSX: FFM)
snippet: FireFly Metals' Q2 2026 quarterly report (July 27) highlights exceptional underground drilling in the high-grade Core Zone at Green Bay, Newfoundland — including 42.0m at 6.1% CuEq (with 9.8m at 16.5% CuEq) and 51.5m at 4.9% CuEq — to be incorporated into an updated resource and PEA/Scoping Study for an upscaled production restart now due August 2026. Current resource: 50.4Mt @ 2.0% CuEq M&I plus 29.3Mt @ 2.5% CuEq Inferred. The quarter also saw S&P/ASX 200 Index inclusion and A$196.4M cash on hand following the sale of Ontario gold assets.

headline: SANTANA DRILLS 2m @ 89.5 g/t Au WITH VISIBLE GOLD AT RISE AND SHINE — 24.4m @ 10.9 g/t Au Envelope De-Risks NZ Open Pit (ASX: SMI)
snippet: Santana Minerals (ASX: SMI) reported bonanza gold intercepts from the Rise and Shine deposit in New Zealand on July 27, with key hole MDD528 returning 24.4 metres at 10.9 g/t gold including a spectacular 2.0-metre interval at 89.5 g/t gold with abundant visible gold. The results confirm a sub-parallel high-grade zone accessible via open pit, materially improving the resource model and de-risking the planned first mining area at the Bendigo-Ophir project.

headline: JAGUAR MINING EXTENDS TURMALINA GOLD SYSTEM WITH 11.88 g/t Au OVER 5.39m AT FAINA — Confirms Post-Restart Resource Growth Drive (CVE: JAG)
snippet: Jaguar Mining (CVE/TSX: JAG) announced July 27 that initial drilling at the Faina orebody within the Turmalina Mine complex in Brazil intercepted multiple high-grade gold zones — best result 11.88 g/t Au over 5.39m — confirming continuity and supporting the company's strategy to expand mineral resources since resuming operations at Turmalina in March 2026. Faina is one of four orebodies in the Turmalina complex, and this drilling campaign underpins the path to full mining resumption.

headline: ZODIAC GOLD SPINS UP FIRST DRILL AT LEWIS TARGET — 1.8km Gold-in-Soil Trend Gets 3,000m Inaugural Test on Liberia's Monterra Trend (TSXV: ZAU)
snippet: Zodiac Gold Inc. (TSXV: ZAU) announced July 27 the commencement of inaugural diamond drilling at the Lewis target at the Todi Gold Project in Liberia — the third target to be drill tested along the 16-kilometre Monterra Trend. The Phase 1 program comprises up to 3,000 metres prioritizing a southern east-west gold-in-soil geochemical trend extending 1.8 kilometres; drilling started July 21 with results pending.

headline: LITHIUM CARBONATE SINKS TO 5-MONTH LOW AT 136,800 YUAN/T — Mine Restart Wave Stokes 2027 Glut Fears as Bald Hill, Finniss, CATL All Return
snippet: Lithium carbonate futures in China fell to 136,800 yuan ($20,210) per tonne — their lowest since February 10 — before partially recovering to close at 144,000 yuan (down 4.95% on the day) as investors weighed a wave of mine restarts: MinRes's Bald Hill (165,000 dmt/yr spodumene, first production July 2026), Core Lithium's Finniss resumption, and CATL's cleared Jianxiawo mine returning approximately 3% of global supply. Global lithium production is forecast to grow 26% year-over-year to 2.16 million tonnes in 2026, raising questions about whether the 2026 price recovery has already peaked.

headline: GOLD SPECS MISSING IN ACTION — Lean 120K-Contract Positioning at $4,083 Historically Precedes Outsized Rally When Macro Catalyst Returns (GoldSeek)
snippet: A GoldSeek analysis argues that speculative COMEX gold positioning remains historically lean relative to the current $4,083 gold price — managed money net longs of approximately 120,000–125,000 contracts represent a floor level of speculative interest typically seen at far lower prices, indicating the rally-capping speculative overhang has not been rebuilt since the April correction from $5,600. When the catalyst returns — FOMC clarity, a rate cut signal, or geopolitical re-escalation — the move higher could be amplified by a crowded re-entry by sidelined specs.

headline: BIG WEEK FOR GOLD AND COPPER: AGNICO EAGLE AND KINROSS REPORT TOMORROW AFTER CLOSE, HUDBAY PRE-MARKET — AEM Consensus $3.24 EPS
snippet: The most pivotal Wednesday of 2026 for Canadian mining investors arrives July 29 as Agnico Eagle Mines (TSX: AEM) and Kinross Gold (TSX: K) both release Q2 2026 results after market close (analysts expect AEM at $3.24 EPS with H2-weighted production), Hudbay Minerals (TSX: HBM) releases Q2 before market open (copper guidance 110,000–138,000 tonnes full year), and Capstone Copper (TSX: CS) follows on July 30 — all coinciding with the FOMC rate decision at 2:00 p.m. ET.
